summary.en: Decouple the offline engine from the optional HTTP client import and verify standard-library-only full games.
summary.zh: 解除离线引擎对 HTTP 客户端导入的依赖，并验证仅标准库环境中的完整对局。

reason: Internal dependency boundary only; existing installation and player entry points are unchanged. The separate Android runtime probe is not a released mobile product.

compatibility.en: No save or configuration schema changes. API play still requires its HTTP dependency and fails explicitly if absent; it never substitutes offline decisions.
compatibility.zh: 存档与配置格式不变。API 模式仍需要 HTTP 依赖，缺失时明确失败，不会降级为离线决策。
